data.description:
Transform your home into a vibrant animal habitat in Living Room, the cozy mixed reality wildlife sanctuary!

❄️ **NEW: Winter Update** ❄️ By popular request: refund islands, play fetch with your pet & more!

-  🗨️ “Charming, relaxing, and fun to play” - Use A Potion
-  🗨️ "Cute as heck!” - AtomBombBody
-  🗨️ "Anyone who enjoyed Starship Home will feel right at home in Living Room." - MIXED News

# Features
- 🏝️ Turn your furniture into vibrant habitats
- 🏆 Complete quests to unlock new content
- 🌈 Breed animals to create unique variants
- 😻 Create your own life-sized virtual pet
- 🧩 Play modes for different playstyles
- 🌻 Decorate your entire Living Room!

······

# 🏝️ Build an Animal Oasis
Use Quest’s surface tracking technology to turn your furniture into lush ecosystems where cute critters can grow and thrive.{1310896103258754}
# 🏆 Solve Quests to Progress
Complete quests to reveal new biomes, animal and plant species, and decorations.{532100329429096}
# 🌈 Breed New Color Variants
Maintain generations of animals over time to unlock a kaleidoscope of new colors.{926099929061539}
# 😻 Create a (Virtual) Pet
Turn your favorite animal into a life-sized pet! Play with your pet to keep it happy and it will reward you by digging up treasures.{2457245274483086}
# 🧩 Multiple Play Modes 
Maintain healthy habitats in Normal Mode, solve tricky puzzles in Challenge Mode, or relax and let your creativity run free in Creative Mode.{1313734683397118}
# 🌻 Customize Your Environment
Decorate not just your animal islands, but your ENTIRE ROOM - with plushies, Polaroids, plants and more.{605729831803353}Bring your home to life with Living Room! 🌱
